as950_controller@Latest/programming.label: Programming
as950_controller@Latest/programming.description: Configures data logging, the alarms and the sampling program.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.label: Datalog Programming
as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.description: Select the measurements to record and how often they are saved to the data log.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.label: Change Port Assignments
as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.description: Select the sensor(s) that will be connected to the Sensor 1 port and the Sensor 2 port.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.label: Channel Logging
as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.description: Select a measurement source and the measurement to record to the data log.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.label: Logging Intervals
as950_controller@Latest/programming.data.description: Sets the primary and secondary logging intervals for each measurement. Options: 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20, 30 or 60 minutes.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Alarm Programming
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Select and configure the alarms that show on the Status screen and are recorded to the alarm log.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Add New Alarm
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Select a system alarm to add: Program Start, Program End, Bottle Change, Pump Forward, Pump Reverse, Sample Complete, Entire Sample, Missed Sample, Purge Error, Distributor Error, Pump Fault, Full Bottle.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Add New Alarm
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Select a channel alarm (setpoint alarm) for a recorded measurement. Options: Low/Low, Low, High, High/High, Rate of Change (rain only).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Low/Low
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Sets the lowest alarm setpoint and the deadband for the lowest alarm setpoint.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Low
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Sets the low alarm setpoint and the deadband for the low alarm setpoint.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: High
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Sets the high alarm setpoint and the deadband for the high alarm setpoint.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: High/High
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Sets the highest alarm setpoint and the deadband for the highest alarm setpoint.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Rate of Change
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Sets the alarm setpoint, deadband and the amount of time for the rate of change (rain only).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Log Only
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Sets the alarm to be recorded to the alarm log when the alarm occurs.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.label: Switch Log Interval
as950_controller@Latest/programming.alar.description: Sets the data logging interval to change to the secondary logging interval while the alarm is active.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Sample Programming
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Configure the sampling program: pacing, volume, distribution, start and stop conditions.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Program Type
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Select the type of sampling program. Options: Custom Single, Custom Dual, CTVV, Stormwater, Setpoint Sampling.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Total Bottles
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Selects the number of bottles in the sampler.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Bottles per Program
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Selects the number of bottles used by each sampling program (Custom Dual and Stormwater only).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Bottle Volume
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Enters the volume capacity of each bottle.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Length
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Enters the length of the intake tubing from the strainer to the liquid detector.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Diameter
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Selects the diameter of the intake tubing: 6.33 mm (¼ in.) or 9.5 mm (3/8 in.).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Pacing
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Select when a sample is collected.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Time Weighted
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Collects a sample at a set time interval. Sets the time interval between samples (1 minute to 999 hours) and whether the first sample is taken immediately or after the first interval.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Flow Weighted
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Collects a sample at a set flow interval. Requires an external flow meter or optional flow sensor. Configures flow source, override, target volume and take-first setting.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Time Table
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Collects a sample at two or more configurable time intervals. Sets number of intervals and configures each interval.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Flow Table
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Collects a sample at two or more configurable flow intervals. Sets number of intervals and configures each interval. Requires an external flow meter or optional flow sensor.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Event
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Collects a sample when one or more selected channel alarms occur. Sets event type, selects channel alarms and event trigger (any or all alarms).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Sample Volume
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Select the volume of each sample.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Fixed
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Sets the sample volume to a fixed quantity (10 to 10,000 mL).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Variable
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Sets the sample volume to increase linearly as the flow rate increases or decreases between a configured low and high flow rate. Requires the liquid detector to be enabled.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Distribution
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Select the sample distribution among the bottles.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Sample Based
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Divides each sample between a selected number of bottles or puts multiple samples in one bottle. Sets Bottles per Sample (BPS) and Samples per Bottle (SPB).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Time Based
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Puts samples collected during a time interval into each bottle. Sets Duration (5 minutes to 24 hours) and First Bottle.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Program Start
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Select when the sampling program starts after RUN/HALT is pushed.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Immediately on Run
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program starts immediately when RUN/HALT is pushed.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: On Trigger
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program starts (or starts and stops) when a trigger occurs.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Setpoint
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Starts the program when selected channel alarms occur. Configures setpoint selection, start trigger (any/all), delay and control (Start Only or Start & Stop).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: External AUX
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Starts the program when the external flow meter or third-party device connected to the AUX I/O port sends a signal. Configures delay and control (Start Only or Start & Stop).

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: After Delay
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program starts after the selected delay. Delay types: None, Date and Time, Time Duration, Flow Duration, Slave Sequential, Slave Parallel.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: On Schedule
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program starts on selected day(s) of the week and time(s). Configures up to 12 schedule intervals and an optional one-time delay.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Program End
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: Select when the sampling program stops.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: None
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program operates continuously.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: After Samples
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program stops after a set number of samples are collected.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Date and Time
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program stops at a set date and time.

as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.label: Time Duration
as950_controller@Latest/programming.samp.description: The sampling program stops after a number of hours (1 to 999 hours).

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.label: Review Data
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.description: Shows the sampling history and the measurement data (data log).

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.samp.label: Sample History
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.samp.description: Shows each sample collected, the time collected and whether collection was completed or not.

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.samp.label: All Samples
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.samp.description: Shows the sample collection time, sample number, bottle number(s) and sample volume for each sample.

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.samp.label: Missed Samples
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.samp.description: Shows the sample collection time, sample number and the reason each sample was not collected.

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.label: Measurement Data
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.description: Shows the measurements recorded to the data log in table or graph format.

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.label: View Type
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.description: Changes the view between table format and graph format.

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.label: Zoom
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.description: Changes the graph view to one week, one day or one hour of measurements (graph view only).

as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.label: Jump to Date & Time
as950_controller@Latest/review_data.meas.description: Shows the measurement recorded at the entered date and time.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Manual Operation
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: Collects a grab sample, moves the distributor arm or operates the pump manually.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Grab Sample
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: Collects a grab sample to verify sample volume or bypass the sampling program.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Sample Volume
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: Enter the volume to collect. If the liquid detector is enabled, enter the volume to be verified; if disabled, enter the volume specified in the sampling program.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Move Distributor Arm
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: Moves the distributor arm to a selected bottle position.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Bottle Number
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: Enter the number of the bottle to move the distributor arm over.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Operate Pump
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: Operates the pump in the forward or reverse direction.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Pump (Run Forward)
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: The pump operates in the forward direction to collect a sample.

as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.label: Purge (Run Backward)
as950_controller@Latest/manual_operation.description: The pump operates in the reverse direction to purge the intake tubing.

as950_controller@Latest/calibration.label: Calibration
as950_controller@Latest/calibration.description: Calibrates the sample volume, attached sensors and the analog input at the AUX port.

as950_controller@Latest/calibration.volu.label: Volume
as950_controller@Latest/calibration.volu.description: Calibrate or adjust the sample volume.

as950_controller@Latest/calibration.volu.label: Sample Volume
as950_controller@Latest/calibration.volu.description: Calibrates the sample volume. With liquid detector enabled, collects a sample and adjusts based on actual volume collected. With liquid detector disabled, calibrates by time.

as950_controller@Latest/calibration.volu.label: User Adjust
as950_controller@Latest/calibration.volu.description: Adjusts the sample volume calibration by entering a percentage adjustment value.

as950_controller@Latest/calibration.sens.label: Sensor Calibration
as950_controller@Latest/calibration.sens.description: Calibrate the sensors connected to the sampler.

as950_controller@Latest/calibration.cabi.label: Cabinet Temp Cal
as950_controller@Latest/calibration.cabi.description:
Calibrate the cabinet temperature (AWRS sampler only).
Refer to the service manual on the manufacturer's website for the calibration procedure.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.label: Hardware Setup
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.description: Configures the sampler, sampler ports and attached sensors. Configures and calibrates the liquid detector.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.s.label: Site ID
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.s.description: Enters the name for the sampling location (16 characters).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.s.label: Rinses
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.s.description: Sets the number of intake tube rinses before a sample is collected (0 to 3).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.s.label: Sample Retries
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.s.description: Sets the number of sampling tries after a sampling failure occurs (0 to 3).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.label: Sensor Options
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.description: Common options available for each sensor.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.label: Setup Wizard
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.description: Configures all the sensor settings and calibrates the sensor following screen prompts.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.label: Flow Settings
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.description: Configures the sensor settings used to calculate flow.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.label: Application Settings
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.description: Configures sensor settings that control sensor operation (US900x only).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.label: Restore Defaults
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.c.description: Sets the sensor settings and calibration back to factory defaults.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: AUX and I/O Port
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Configures the AUX I/O port for connection to a Hach flow meter or third-party device.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: Type
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Sets the port type: AUX or RS485 (configured via Rain and RS485 Port).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: Mode
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Sets the AUX I/O port mode. Options: Sample Event (sends sample info to a flow meter when a sample is collected), Program Complete (sends a signal when the sampling program is complete).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: Flow Reading
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Selects the type of flow input signal from the flow meter. Options: AUX-Pulse or AUX-mA (4–20 mA).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: Flow Unit
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Selects the flow units shown on the display (AUX-mA mode). Options: m³ or L per day, hour, minute or second.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: 4mA Value
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Enters the flow volume that corresponds to a 4 mA input at the AUX I/O port.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: 20mA Value
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Enters the flow volume that corresponds to a 20 mA input at the AUX I/O port.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: Calibrate
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Calibrates the analog input by supplying 4 mA and 20 mA to the AUX I/O port.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.label: Restore Defaults
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.a.description: Sets the AUX I/O port settings and analog input calibration to factory defaults.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.l.label: Liquid Detect
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.l.description: Enables, disables and calibrates the liquid detector.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.l.label: Status
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.l.description: Enables or disables the liquid detector. Enabled (default): uses the liquid detector to sense liquid in the tube for volume accuracy. Disabled: for pressurized lines or when the sampler is below the sample source.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.l.label: Calibrate
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.l.description: Calibrates the liquid detector (only with guidance of technical support).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.label: Rain and RS485 Port
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.description: Configures the Rain port for a Hach tipping bucket rain gauge or RS485 communications.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.label: Modbus Address
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.description: Sets the Modbus address when RS485 is selected (1 to 255).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.label: Baud Rate
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.description: Sets the baud rate when RS485 is selected. Options: 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600 or 115200.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.label: Parity
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.r.description: Sets the parity when RS485 is selected. Options: None, Even or Odd.

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.t.label: Thermal
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.t.description: Sets and calibrates the temperature inside the AWRS refrigerated cabinet (AWRS sampler only).

as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.t.label: Cabinet Temperature
as950_controller@Latest/hardware_setup.t.description: Sets the temperature inside the AWRS refrigerated cabinet. Options: 2.00 to 10.00 °C (default: 4.00 °C).

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.label: diagnostics
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.description: Shows status, logs and memory use. Runs diagnostic tests on components.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.stat.label: status_diag
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.stat.description: Shows the Status screen including sample status, data log status, alarm status and hardware status.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.even.label: event_log
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.even.description: Shows the event log. Displays total events and occurrences per event type.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.alar.label: alarm_log
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.alar.description: Shows the alarm log. Displays total alarms and occurrences per alarm type.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.sens.label: sensor_ports
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.sens.description: Triggers the connected sensors to do a measurement and shows advanced diagnostic information, sensor type and firmware version.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.aux_.label: aux_io_diag
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.aux_.description: Shows the configuration settings for the AUX I/O port, the flow input signal and the flow value.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.dist.label: distributor
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.dist.description: Moves the distributor arm to all bottle positions to test distributor arm operation.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.keyp.label: keypad
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.keyp.description: Shows each key that is pushed on the keypad for keypad testing.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.disp.label: display
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.disp.description: Sets each pixel of the display to on and off in different patterns for display testing.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.memo.label: memory
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.memo.description: Shows the percent of controller memory used.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.pump.label: pump
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.pump.description: Shows total run time, forward run time and reverse run time of the pump motor.

as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.pump.label: Reset Counters
as950_controller@Latest/diagnostics.pump.description: Resets the pump cycle count to 0 after the pump tubing is changed.

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: general_settings
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Shows instrument information. Configures display, security, units, tubing life. Erases data.

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: about
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Shows system information: model name, model type, serial number, boot firmware version, firmware version and firmware build date.

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: date_and_time
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Sets the time and date and selects the format. Options: dd/mm/yyyy 12h, dd/mm/yyyy 24h, mm/dd/yyyy 12h, mm/dd/yyyy 24h, yyyy/mm/dd 12h, yyyy/mm/dd 24h.

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: display_settings
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Adjusts the brightness of the display (default: 50%).

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: security
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Enables security for password protection. When enabled, user settings that can change log data or the sampling program require a password. Password must be re-entered when the display switches off or the controller power is set to off.

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: unit_preferences
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Sets the system of measurement (US Customary or Metric) and individual measurement units shown on the display (level, velocity, flow, temperature, surface velocity, distance, minimum distance, maximum distance, surge level, rain, cabinet temperature, level raw and surge velocity).

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: tubing_life
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Sets a reminder when the pump tubing is to be changed. Enter the number of pump cycles for the reminder (10 to 99,999). An event is recorded to the event log when total pump cycles exceed the set value.

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: clear_data
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Erases the sample history and/or selected logs. Options: Sample History, Data Log, Event Log, Alarm Log, Diagnostics Log.

as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.label: restore_factory_defaults
as950_controller@Latest/general_settings.description: Sets all controller settings back to factory defaults and erases logs and sample history. The display shows the startup screen for approximately 2 minutes during the restore process.

as950_controller@Latest/export_import.label: export_import
as950_controller@Latest/export_import.description: Saves measurement data, sample history and program settings to a USB flash drive. Copies program settings from a USB flash drive to the sampler.

as950_controller@Latest/export_import.ex.label: export_data
as950_controller@Latest/export_import.ex.description: Saves a copy of user settings, log files, sample history and manufacturer settings to the USB flash drive in FSDATA Desktop format.

as950_controller@Latest/export_import.ex.label: export_settings
as950_controller@Latest/export_import.ex.description: Saves a copy of the user settings to the USB flash drive. Select a filename (Settings 1 to 10).

as950_controller@Latest/export_import.im.label: import_settings
as950_controller@Latest/export_import.im.description: Shows the configuration files saved to the USB flash drive and copies the selected file to the controller. Replaces all user settings and erases log data.

as950_controller@Latest/export_import.us.label: usb_drive_info
as950_controller@Latest/export_import.us.description: Shows the total, used and free memory on the USB flash drive.

sc200@2.06/diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
sc200@2.06/diagnostics.description: View warnings and errors for the controller and connected devices.

sc200@2.06/sensor_setup.label: Sensor Setup
sc200@2.06/sensor_setup.description: Configuration for connected sensors and modules.

sc200@2.06/sc200_setup.datalog_setup.label: Datalog Setup
sc200@2.06/sc200_setup.datalog_setup.description: Available only if a calculation has been set up.

sc200@2.06/sc200_setup.discrete_input_se.label: Discrete Input Setup
sc200@2.06/sc200_setup.discrete_input_se.description: Discrete inputs are assigned to affect specific sensors/slots

sc200@2.06/network_setup.label: Network Setup
sc200@2.06/network_setup.description: Only appears if a network or analog output module is installed.

sc200@2.06/sd_card_setup.label: SD Card Setup
sc200@2.06/sd_card_setup.description: Menu for managing files and updates via SD card.

sc4500@3.90/devices.label: Devices
sc4500@3.90/devices.description: Shows all connected measurement devices and their current readings.

sc4500@3.90/notifications.label: Notifications
sc4500@3.90/notifications.description: Shows system messages, alarm conditions, pending tasks and information about the system.

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.label: General
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.description: Configure the controller language, time, date, facility, location and display options.

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.language.label: Language
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.language.description: Sets the language shown on the controller display and in the log files.

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.time_zone.label: Time zone
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.time_zone.description: Sets the time zone by region and city.

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.time_form.label: Time format
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.time_form.description: Sets the time format: 12 h (default) or 24 h.

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.facility.label: Facility
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.facility.description: Sets the name of the facility (32 characters maximum).

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.location.label: Location
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.location.description: Sets the name of the location (32 characters maximum).

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.device_me.label: Device menu
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.device_me.description: Shows the controller name and serial number; allows changing the Name setting.

sc4500@3.90/controller.general.display.label: Display
sc4500@3.90/controller.general.display.description: Sets display options including brightness, screen lock, and waiting time (inactivity period).

sc4500@3.90/controller.password.label: Password
sc4500@3.90/controller.password.description: Set password protection to prevent unwanted changes to specific controller settings and device menus.

sc4500@3.90/controller.password.password.label: Password protection
sc4500@3.90/controller.password.password.description: Enables or disables password protection for protected menus.

sc4500@3.90/controller.password.change_p.label: Change password
sc4500@3.90/controller.password.change_p.description: Changes the controller password (4–8 characters, case sensitive, alphanumeric and special characters).

sc4500@3.90/controller.connectivity.label: Connectivity
sc4500@3.90/controller.connectivity.description: Configure network connectivity options for the controller.

sc4500@3.90/controller.connectivity.lan..label: Ethernet ports
sc4500@3.90/controller.connectivity.lan..description: Sets the Ethernet port configuration: None, Chaining, Split, Mix IEP, or IEP only.

sc4500@3.90/controller.connectivity.lan..label: LAN port configuration

3700_cond_gateway@All/settings.cell_cons.description: Changes the cell constant to the actual certified K value from the label on the sensor cable; default: 4.70; only available when Measurement Type is set to Conductivity or Salinity.
